description: Large stablecoin and major-token transfers in the last few minutes on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: hash, block time, sender, receiver, amount and USD value at the Coinbase spot price, sorted by value. Labels only for a few known addresses; others are null. One token contract is read over public RPC, so the window is short. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Blocks to scan back from the latest: ethereum 10 (default, max 25), base and optimism 20 (max 40), arbitrum and polygon 40 (max 80)

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

minUsd.description: Minimum USD value per transfer, default 1000000, at least 10000

token.description: USDC (default), USDT, WETH, WBTC or cbBTC, where the chain has it
